title: なぜかな、なぜかな (Naze Kana, Naze Kana)
description: A delightfully curious child named Hoshi asks 'why?' about everything — why is the sky blue, why do cats purr, why does rice taste better with chopsticks, why do we wave goodbye? Each answer leads to another why. A long, cumulative, participatory story that celebrates childlike curiosity about the world.
author: オリジナル
